roles.name: Asset Owner
roles.description: The organisation or entity responsible for the operation, safety, and security of an industrial automation and control system (IACS).

roles.name: Product Supplier
roles.description: The manufacturer or vendor who develops industrial hardware components, PLCs, DCS, and software applications.

roles.name: Service Provider
roles.description: Third-party integrators, maintenance contractors, and consultants who install, configure, or service industrial control systems.

overlaps.name: Asset Owner & Service Provider Intersection
overlaps.description: Standards applicable when asset owners collaborate with service providers for operational protection and system design.

overlaps.name: Asset Owner & Product Supplier Intersection
overlaps.description: Shared metrics and foundational concepts applied during procurement and deployment.

overlaps.name: Product Supplier & Service Provider Intersection
overlaps.description: Integration and component standards applied when suppliers and integrators work together.

overlaps.name: All Roles Intersection (Universal Foundation)
overlaps.description: The central core of the ISA/IEC 62443 series that applies universally to all stakeholders in the industrial ecosystem.

independentCircles.name: Profiles Group
independentCircles.description: Standards defining security profiles for specific industrial domains and sectors (e.g., electric energy OT).

independentCircles.name: Conformity Assessment
independentCircles.description: Methodologies for independent auditors and test laboratories performing security evaluations.

62443-1-1.title: Concepts and models
62443-1-1.explanation: Universal terminology, concepts, and foundational models (such as the Purdue Reference Model and security zones) required by all stakeholders.

62443-1-3.title: System security conformance metrics
62443-1-3.explanation: Quantitative security metrics derived from process and technical requirements for asset owners and suppliers.

62443-1-5.title: Scheme for 62443 Cyber Security Profiles
62443-1-5.explanation: Framework for defining and tailoring security profiles across industrial sectors.

62443-2-1.title: Security programme requirements for IACS asset owners
62443-2-1.explanation: Core requirements for asset owners to define and implement an effective IACS security programme.

62443-2-2.title: Security protection rating
62443-2-2.explanation: Methodology for evaluating the protection level of operational IACS against 62443 requirements.

62443-2-3.title: Patch management in the IACS environment
62443-2-3.explanation: Guidance on safely applying software and firmware patches in industrial control environments.

62443-2-4.title: Requirements for IACS service providers
62443-2-4.explanation: Mandatory requirements for third-party service providers, system integrators, and maintenance vendors.

62443-3-2.title: Security risk assessment and system design
62443-3-2.explanation: Risk assessment methodology outputting the Zone & Conduit model and Target Security Levels.

62443-3-3.title: System security requirements and security levels
62443-3-3.explanation: System-level technical requirements and Security Levels (SL 1 to SL 4) for integrated IACS architectures.

62443-4-1.title: Secure product development lifecycle requirements
62443-4-1.explanation: Mandatory secure lifecycle practices for product manufacturers building industrial control devices.

62443-4-2.title: Technical security requirements for IACS components
62443-4-2.explanation: Technical security requirements for embedded devices, host devices, network components, and software applications.

62443-5-1.title: Security Profile - Electric Energy OT
62443-5-1.explanation: Specific security profile tailoring 62443 standards for the electric power and energy sector.

62443-5-2.title: Security Profile - Oil & Gas
62443-5-2.explanation: Specific security profile for oil and gas upstream, midstream, and downstream operations.

62443-5-n.title: Other Industry Profiles
62443-5-n.explanation: Framework for future sector-specific profiles (chemical, water, manufacturing).

62443-6-1.title: Security evaluation methodology for 62443-2-4
62443-6-1.explanation: Evaluation methodology for auditing service providers against 62443-2-4.

62443-6-2.title: Security evaluation methodology for components
62443-6-2.explanation: Testing methodology for independent test labs to evaluate components against 62443-4-2.

alignmentPhases.name: Prevention
alignmentPhases.description: Proactive measures to establish security governance, identify critical assets, segment networks, and ensure secure product procurement before incidents occur.

standards.title: Establishing a security management system
standards.description: Defining organisational policies, asset owner responsibilities, and security programmes.

standards.title: Identifying critical assets and zone-based security
standards.description: Conducting cybersecurity risk assessments and establishing the Zone & Conduit model.

standards.title: Patch management to close known vulnerabilities
standards.description: Implementing structured patch evaluation and deployment schedules.

standards.title: Procuring secure-by-design components
standards.description: Ensuring product suppliers follow secure development lifecycle standards.

standards.title: Target Security Levels (SL 1–4)
standards.description: Specifying system and component security capabilities aligned with risk.

alignmentPhases.name: Detection
alignmentPhases.description: Continuous monitoring, anomaly detection, and real-time event logging to identify unauthorised access or malicious activity instantly.

standards.title: Continuous monitoring and anomaly detection
standards.description: Implementing system-level auditing, intrusion detection, and log management.

standards.title: Device logging and alerting capabilities
standards.description: Ensuring physical components support secure event generation and transmission.

alignmentPhases.name: Response
alignmentPhases.description: Coordinated incident response, communication protocols, and containment procedures involving asset owners and service providers.

standards.title: Incident response and communication plans
standards.description: Establishing clear escalation paths, containment strategies, and stakeholder communication.

standards.title: Service provider incident support
standards.description: Ensuring third-party integrators and maintainers follow incident management protocols.

alignmentPhases.name: Recovery
alignmentPhases.description: Restoring secure zones, verifying system integrity, and implementing backup strategies to return operational processes safely.

standards.title: Recovery plans and backup strategies
standards.description: Maintaining verified offline backups and disaster recovery procedures.

standards.title: Restoring secure zones and conduits
standards.description: Re-establishing secure network segmentation and verifying conduit integrity post-incident.
